opfv1_refinement_gap.evidence: Verifies abstract contract locales only; no verified refinement or executable extraction to Debezium, Flink CDC, or PostgreSQL (`README.md:117`).

opfv2_env_fault_assumptions.evidence: Explicitly unmodeled assumptions (`README.md:77-79,117`): per-key in-order transport, PostgreSQL transaction visibility, select/span completeness, sink key-order equality, concurrent sink writers, >1 connector restart, crash inside a close block, and pre-pass committed offsets.

opfv5_evolution_maintenance_debt.evidence: Maintaining three parallel specifications (Isabelle/HOL + Lean 4 + 3 TLA+ modules) already exhibits drift: `Range_Merge` unported to Lean, 4 unfixed TLA+ review limitations (`tla/README.md:123-125`), and 6 TLA+ configs not re-run on the final module (`tla/README.md:94-97`).

papers.title: Formally Verifiable Generative AI via Dependent Type Theory: Proof-Carrying Certificates for Embeddings, Retrieval, Reasoning, and Agent Actions
multi_tool_stack: Lean 4 + Mathlib dependent certificate schemas (22 certificate structs)
table1_transfers: CRITICAL — Mode #6 (Inconsistent Custom Axiom): 18 total `axiom` declarations (8 ML/crypto oracles + 7 worked-example axioms + 3 unproved mathematical theorems postulated despite importing Mathlib: `cauchy_schwarz_sq` [`Certificate.lean:26`], `innerProd_sub` [`Certificate.lean:31`], `HoeffdingInequality` [`Concentration.lean:44`]). Moreover, `innerProd_sub` is PROVABLY INCONSISTENT (derives `False`): `Embedding := List Rat` (`Basic.lean:17`) and `innerProd` (`Basic.lean:29-32`) + `List.zipWith` truncate to min length, so `innerProd_sub [1] [] [1]` asserts `0 = 1`!

CRITICAL — Mode #1/#4 (Tautological Struct-Projection 'Theorems' & Docstring Drift): >12 headline theorems are 1-line projections of assumed proof fields inside certificate structs with no operational transition semantics — `cegar_terminates := cegar.p_within_budget` (`CEGAR.lean:55-58`), `step_post_holds`/`step_executor_matches`/`trajectory_all_steps_safe` (`Action.lean:80-102`), `all_oracles_in_scope` (`ScopeOfValidity.lean:39-43`), `hoeffding_confidence_interval := cert.h_hoeffding_valid` (`Concentration.lean:117-120`), all 5 theorems in `Additional.lean:44,67,115,136,210`, and `MCR.lean:19-20,78-82` where `MCRCertificate` omits the `p_maximal_over_all` maximality field promised by its own docstring so `residue_is_fixed_point` reduces to `cert.p_residue_cert`.

opfv1_refinement_gap.evidence: The Lean artifact defines standalone certificate records and toy examples; the Python empirical pilots (`pilot_a/b/c`) never emit or kernel-check Lean certificates (`lean_artifact/README.txt:218-221` defers production wrapper deployment to future work).

opfv2_env_fault_assumptions.evidence: 8 uninterpreted ML/crypto/distributional oracles (`ParaphraseOracle`, `SignedSupportOracle`, `DecompositionOracle`, `StepConfidenceOracle`, `IIDSamples`, `Hash`, `HashCollisionResistant`, `DecodeAlgorithmDeterministic`) plus 7 axioms asserting that toy examples satisfy them (`Example.lean:47`, `GroundingExample.lean:95-98`, `CoTExample.lean:34`, `ConcentrationExample.lean:44-48`, `ProofOfSamplingExample.lean:27`).

opfv3_safety_without_liveness_or_vacuity.evidence: `CEGAR.lean:30-58` models no repair loop or progress condition; `cegar_terminates` merely projects the assumed `history.length ≤ budget` field, and `HoeffdingInequality` (`Concentration.lean:44-45`) is an uninterpreted `Prop` unconnected to `2*exp(-2*k*eps^2)`.

opfv4_extraction_tcb_or_cross_kernel_gap.evidence: No executable extraction or runtime monitor lowering exists.

opfv5_evolution_maintenance_debt.evidence: Compact 2,381-LoC schema prototype, though docstring-to-code drift already appears in `MCR.lean:19-20` vs. lines 37–49.

papers.title: Conflict-Freedom as a Progress Condition

sandbox_build.notes: Excluded from compact (<15k LoC) sandbox cohort due to 34,257 LoC size; includes repo-native exhaustive `CFLeanProof/KernelAudit.lean` enforcing all modules imported and zero non-standard axioms across all 2,061 theorems.

multi_tool_stack: Pure Lean 4 Std-only concurrent distributed algorithms mechanization (101 files, 0 external deps)

table1_misfires.evidence: Zero Mathlib imports (`README.md:52-53`) is a deliberate zero-dependency design choice for shared-memory distributed concurrency (linearizability, traces, GCA, universal constructions), where Mathlib provides no domain abstractions; `CFLeanProof/Paper.lean` restates every definition verbatim next to PODC '26 prose.

Flagged solely by the >20k LoC heuristic (34,257 LoC), yet spans 101 clean, modular files proving every numbered PODC theorem (safety on infinite histories + liveness + Algorithm 2 GCA + deterministic machines + counterexamples + contention/helping/adopt witnesses) with zero unimported files enforced by `CFLeanProof/KernelAudit.lean:14-43`.

table1_transfers: Layer B (Mode #6): zero sorry, zero custom axioms, zero native_decide; enforced programmatically across all `ConflictFreedom.*` declarations by `CFLeanProof/KernelAudit.lean:32-41`.

Mode #4 (non-vacuity): exemplary concrete execution witnesses (`ContentionWitness.lean`, `HelpingWitness.lean`, `AdoptWitness.lean`, `LinearizationWitness.lean`, `Counterexamples.lean`) and explicit guard against `n = 0` vacuity (`MODEL.md:56-58`).

opfv1_refinement_gap.evidence: Models Algorithms 1–3 as deterministic abstract machines (`ForwardUniversal.lean`, `ForwardHelping.lean`), but assumes atomic snapshot objects rather than proving refinement to wait-free read/write registers (`README.md:102-107`, `MODEL.md:12-14`), and has no verified systems-language (C/Rust/Java) implementation.

opfv2_env_fault_assumptions.evidence: Two explicit model assumptions (`README.md:97-107`): (1) each local trace computation is one atomic step; (2) Algorithm 2 executes over atomic wait-free snapshot objects (Afek et al. 1993 read/write implementation cited, not formalized).

opfv3_safety_without_liveness_or_vacuity.evidence: Proves BOTH safety (infinite-history linearizability, Thm 4.3 / Lem 6.1) AND liveness (weak conflict-freedom / conflict-freedom progress, Thm 4.4 / Lem 6.2; conflict forgetting/resolution solo extensions, Thm 7.2 / 7.4), backed by non-vacuous contention/helping/adopt witnesses (`README.md:88-93`).

opfv4_extraction_tcb_or_cross_kernel_gap.evidence: No external extraction or FFI; decidable local trace computations are evaluated inside Lean's kernel (`README.md:90-93`).

opfv5_evolution_maintenance_debt.evidence: 34,257 LoC across 101 Lean files for one PODC paper illustrates the substantial specification/proof maintenance surface of full safety+liveness concurrency mechanizations.
